svg.text: EPSS 2026/27 · Part 1 — what the template gives and what students write
Water balance and long-term simulation of a reservoir · template repository epss_code · 12 library functions, 11 notebook cells, 1 test and the README to complete
data/ — provided; case.json holds every parameter that may vary
case.json · hmax, hmin, A0, D, f
one notebook per task; each consumes the previous output
src/epss/ — functions are tested by pytest; TODOs raise NotImplementedError
deficit L, soil S, AET, H
f × mean Qin of the same
notebooks/ — markdown, plots and the outputs of a full solution are kept as reference
tests/ — pytest, run by GitHub Actions on every push; reference = synthetic case in data/reference/
catchment series, fixed- and variable-area simulations, required hmax vs expected results
download and exploration are checked by running the notebooks
